params.body:
This is phase 1 of `docs/content-architectuur.md` in hoet-eyewear (#83): it adds the journal to the Studio. Every change is an addition; existing types and documents are untouched.

**Schema**
- `journalPost` has these fields:
  - brand, internal name, title, slug, excerpt and hero image;
  - `body` (`articleBody`), category, tags, author, `publishedAt` and `contentUpdatedAt`;
  - frames and collections it links to, `seo` and `noindex`;
  - `inNewsletter` and `newsletterTeaser`.
- A `publishedAt` in the future schedules the article. The list shows it as *ingepland* and sorts newest first.
- `articleBody` has one Portable Text array per language, the same shape as `localeBlock`.
  - Members: `block`, `divider`, `figure`, `gallery`, `video`, `embed`, `quote`, `framePick` and `callToAction`.
  - Annotations: `link` and `internalLink`. `internalLink` is a weak reference to a frame, collection, page or article, with a warning when the target is unpublished.
- `seo` becomes its own object with length warnings. `page` and `fair` keep their inline object.
- New supporting documents: `author` (shared across brands), plus `journalCategory` and `journalTag` (both brand-scoped).

**Validation**
- Publishing is blocked when any of these is missing:
  - the Dutch title, slug and excerpt;
  - a hero image with Dutch alt text, at least 1200 px wide;
  - a category, an author and a publish date;
  - alt text on every figure, gallery image and video;
  - for an embed: a URL the site can play (youtube.com/watch, youtu.be or vimeo.com), its own still and a title.
- It is also blocked when:
  - a slug is already used by another published article of the same brand, in the same language;
  - the Dutch body opens with a heading.
- These are warnings only:
  - a half-translated language;
  - a video over 25 MB;
  - a full-width figure under 1200 px;
  - meta title and description lengths;
  - a `contentUpdatedAt` earlier than the publish date.

**Studio**
- *Voorbeeld* opens `https://hoet.be/{lang}/journal/preview/{id}`. That route arrives with phase 2 on the site; until then the action leads to a 404.
- *Opbouw overnemen uit Nederlands* copies the Dutch body into an empty language, with the text emptied and the images, videos and references kept. It patches the draft through the Studio.
- *Journal* sits under Hoet (articles, categories, tags) and *Auteurs* under *Gedeeld*.
- Categories have no "new" option.

**Contract with the site**
- Two fixtures will be read by the site's tests as well:
  - `tests/fixtures/article-body-members.json` holds the names of the body members;
  - `tests/fixtures/embed-urls.json` holds the embed URL cases.
- `tests/article-body.test.ts` checks the members and the URL parser against these fixtures, and also covers the copy-structure transform and the category seed.
- `tests/config.test.ts` gets the journal invariants, checked against the published dataset.

**After merge**
1. `npm run deploy`
2. `npx sanity exec scripts/seed-journal-categories.mjs --with-user-token -- --dry`, then the same command without `--dry`. It creates the five categories with fixed ids, using `createIfNotExists` on published documents only.

**Checked**
- Passing: `tsc --noEmit`, `sanity schema validate` (0 errors, 0 warnings), `sanity build`, and the offline vitest suite (61 tests).
- Not run: the live `config.test.ts`, because no read token was available.
- Not exercised in a running Studio.
